card.line: Maon was a city in the hill country of Judah, and the nearby wilderness became a hiding place for David when King Saul hunted him.

moments.title: David hides from Saul
moments.text: David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon when Saul came looking for him. David went down to the rock and stayed there, and Saul pursued him.

moments.title: Nabal's home
moments.text: A very wealthy man named Nabal lived in Maon, but his business was in Carmel. He owned a thousand goats and three thousand sheep.
